items.title: Ukraine: Russian drone hits nuclear-fuel storage facility
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called a Russian attack on a nuclear storage facility near Chernobyl "vile." The UN's nuclear watchdog said no increased radiation had been registered at the site.

items.title: North Korea says nuclear program 'absolutely nonnegotiable'
items.description: Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, has reaffirmed the country's nuclear ambitions ahead of a visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping.

items.title: Armenia, once Russia's reliable ally, considers an EU future
items.description: Armenians are set to vote on the country's future geopolitical direction on June 7. The election will be a test of public opinion in the long-standing Russia ally, where the population is increasingly eyeing the EU.

items.title: Armenia goes to polls, with Russia and EU looking on
items.description: Armenians are voting in elections that pit pro-EU Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan against the pro-Russia opposition. Peace efforts with longtime foe Azerbaijan are also a main election issue.

items.title: Kosovo holds third election in 16 months
items.description: Voters in Kosovo are heading to the polls in a snap vote called to resolve a parliamentary stalemate. The country's prolonged political crisis has further debilitated an already ailing economy.

items.title: Taiwan deploys vessels in response to Chinese operation
items.description: Taiwan's coast guard confronts Chinese vessels near the island after Beijing launched what it called a "law enforcement operation."
